arabic_text: أَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهارَ بِقُوَّتِهِ، وَمَيَّزَ بَيْنَهُمَا بِقُدْرَتِهِ، وَجَعَلَ لِكُلِّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا حَدّاً مَحْدُوداً، وَأَمَداً مَمْدُوداً ،
transliteration: al-ḥamdulillāhi al-ladhī khalaqa al-layla wa al-nahāra bi quwwatih wa mayyaza baynahuma bi qudratihi wa jaʿala li-kulli wāḥidin minhumā ḥaddan maḥdūdan, wa ʾamadan mamdūdan
english_text: Praise belongs to God, who created night and day through His strength, set them apart through His power, and appointed for each a determined limit and a drawn-out period.

arabic_text: يُولِجُ كُلَّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا فِي صَاحِبِهِ، وَيُولِجُ صَاحِبَهُ فِيهِ بِتَقْدِير مِنْهُ لِلْعِبَادِ فِيمَا يَغْـذُوهُمْ بِـهِ وَيُنْشئُهُمْ عَلَيْـهِ،
transliteration: yu'liju kulla wahidin minhuma fi sahibihi wa yu'lijus sahibahu feehi bitaqdeer minhu lil'ibad fīmā yaghḍūhum bihī wa yunshuʾuhum ʿalayh
english_text: He makes each of the two enter into its companion, and makes its companion enter into it, as an ordainment from Him for His servants in that through which He feeds them and with which He makes them grow.

arabic_text: فَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ اللَّيْـلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا فِيْهِ مِنْ حَرَكَاتِ التَّعَبِ، وَنَهَضَاتِ النَّصَبِ، وَجَعَلَهُ لِبَاساً لِيَلْبَسُوا مِنْ رَاحَتِهِ وَمَنَامِهِ، فَيَكُونَ ذَلِكَ جَمَاماً وَقُوَّةً، وَلِيَنَالُوا بِهِ لَذَّةً وَشَهْوَةً.
transliteration: fakhalaqa lahumu allayla liyaskunu fihi min harakat al-taʿabi wa nahạðāti al-naşabi, wa jaʿalahu libāsan liyalbasū min rāhatihi wa manāmihi fayakūna dhālika jamāman wa quwwatan, wa liyanālu bihi lazzatan wa shahwatan
english_text: He created for them the night, "that they might rest in it" (10:67) from tiring movements and wearisome exertions and He made it a garment for them that they might be clothed in its ease and its sleep, that it might be for them refreshment and strength, that they might reach therein pleasure and passion.

arabic_text: وَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ النَّهارَ مُبْصِراً لِيَبْتَغُوا فِيهِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ، وَلِيَتَسَبَّبُوا إلَى رِزْقِهِ، وَيَسْرَحُوا فِي أَرْضِهِ، طَلَباً لِمَا فِيـهِ نَيْلُ الْعَاجِلِ مِنْ دُنْيَاهُمْ، وَدَرَكُ الاجِلِ فِيْ اُخْراهُمْ. بِكُلِّ ذلِكَ يُصْلِحُ شَأنَهُمْ،
transliteration: wa khalaqa lahumun-nahara mubṣirā liyabtaghū fīhi min faḍlih waliyatasabbabu ila rizqihi, wayasraḥu fi ardhihi ṭalaban limā fīhi naylul-ʿājili min dunyāhum wa daraka al-ajli fee ukhrahum. bikulli dhalika yuslihu sha'anahum
english_text: He created for them the daytime, "giving sight, that they might seek within it of His bounty" (ref. 17:12) find the means to His provision, and roam freely in His earth, searching for that through which to attain the immediate in their life in this world and to achieve the deferred in their life to come. Through all of this He sets right their situation,

arabic_text: وَيَبْلُو أَخْبَارَهُمْ وَيَنْظُرُ كَيْفَ هُمْ فِي أَوْقَاتِ طَاعَتِـهِ، وَمَنَازِلِ فُـرُوضِهِ وَمَوَاقِعِ أَحْكَامِهِ لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى.
transliteration: wa yablu akhbarahum wa yanzuru kayfa hum fi awqati ta'atih wa manazili furūdhihi wa mawāqiʿi aḥkāmihi li-yajziya alladhina asa'u bima 'amilu wa yajziya alladhina ahsanu bil-husna
english_text: tries their records, and watches their state in the times for obeying Him, the waystations of His obligations, and the places of His ordinances, that He may repay those who do evil with what they have done and repay those who do good with goodness.

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَافَلَقْتَ لَنَا مِنَ الإصْبَاحِ، وَمَتَّعْتَنَا بِهِ مِنْ ضَوْءِ النَّهَارِ، وَبَصَّرْتَنَا مِنْ مَطَالِبِ الاقْوَاتِ، وَوَقَيْتَنَا فِيهِ مِنْ طَوارِقِ الآفاتِ.
transliteration: allāhumma fala(k)a al-ḥamdu ʿalā mā fala(q)ta lanā mina al-ṣubḥ wa mattaʿtanā bihī min ḍawʾi al-nahār wa baṣṣartanā min maṭālibi al-aqwāt wa waqaytanā fīhi min ṭawāriqi al-āfāt
english_text: O God, to Thee belongs praise for the sky Thou hast split into dawn for us, giving us to enjoy thereby the brightness of daytime, showing us sought-after nourishments, and protecting us from the striking of blights.

arabic_text: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَتِ الاَشْياءُ كُلُّهَا بِجُمْلَتِهَا لَكَ: سَمَاؤُها وَأَرْضُهَا وَمَا بَثَثْتَ فِي كُلِّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا سَاكِنُهُ وَمُتَحَرِّكُهُ وَمُقِيمُهُ وَشَاخِصُهُ وَمَا عَلا فِي الْهَواءِ وَمَا كَنَّ تَحْتَ الثَّرى
transliteration: aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥatil ashya'u kulluhā bi jumlatihā laka: samāʾuhā wa arḍuhā wa mā baththta fī kulli wāḥid minhumā sākinuhu wa mutaḥarrikuhu wa muqīmuhu wa shākhisuhu wa mā ʿalā fī al-hawāʾ wa mā kanna taḥta al-tharra
english_text: In the morning we and all things, every one, rise for Thee, the heaven and the earth and what Thou hast scattered in each, the still and the moving, the resident and the journeying, what towers up in the air and what hides under the ground.

arabic_text: أَصْبَحْنَا فِي قَبْضَتِكَ يَحْوِينَا مُلْكُكَ وَسُلْطَانُكَ وَتَضُمُّنَا مَشِيَّتُكَ،
transliteration: ʾaṣbaḥnā fī qabḍatika yaḥwīnā mulkuka wa sulṭānuka wa taḍummunā mashīyatuka
english_text: We rise in the morning in Thy grasp: Thy kingdom and authority contain us and Thy will embraces us.

arabic_text: وَنَتَصَرَّفُ عَنْ أَمْرِكَ، وَنَتَقَلَّبُ فِيْ تَدْبِيرِكَ
transliteration: wa nataṣarrafu ʿan amrika, wa nataqallabu fi tadbiirika
english_text: We move about by Thy command and turn this way and that through Thy governing.

arabic_text: لَيْسَ لَنَا مِنَ الامْرِ إلاّ مَا قَضَيْتَ وَلا مِنَ الْخَيْـرِ إلا مَـا أَعْطَيْتَ.
transliteration: laysa lana min al-amri illa ma qadayta wa laa min al-khayri illa ma a'tayta
english_text: We own nothing of the affair except what Thou hast decreed and nothing of the good except what Thou hast given.

arabic_text: وَهَذَا يَوْمٌ حَادِثٌ جَدِيدٌ، وَهُوَ عَلَيْنَا شَاهِدٌ عَتِيدٌ ،
transliteration: wa-ha-dha yawmun ha-dithun ja-didun, wa-huwa 'alay-na sha-hidun 'a-tidun
english_text: This is a fresh, new day, over us a ready witness.

arabic_text: إنْ أحْسَنَّا وَدَّعَنَا بِحَمْد، وَإِنْ أسَأنا فارَقَنا بِذَمّ
transliteration: ʾin aḥsannā waddaʿanā biḥamd, waʾin asaʾanā faraqanā bidhimm
english_text: If we do good, it will take leave from us with praise, and if we do evil, it will part from us in blame.

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَد وَآلِـهِ وَارْزُقْنَـا حُسْنَ مُصَاحَبَتِهِ وَاعْصِمْنَا مِنْ سُوْءِ مُفَارَقَتِهِ بِارْتِكَابِ جَرِيرَة، أَوِ اقْتِرَافِ صَغِيرَة أوْ كَبِيرَة.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa arzuqna husna muṣāḥabatihī wa aʿṣimnā min suu'i mufaraqatihi bi-irtikabi jarirah aw iqtiraf sagheeratan aw kabeeratan
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, provide us with the day's good companionship and preserve us against parting from it badly by doing a misdeed or committing a sin, whether small or great!

arabic_text: وَأجْزِلْ لَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَسَناتِ وَأَخْلِنَا فِيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئاتِ.
transliteration: wa-ajzil lana fihi min al-hasanat wa-akhlinā fihi mina al-sayyi'at
english_text: Make our good deeds within it plentiful empty us therein of evil deeds,

arabic_text: وَامْلا لَنَا مَا بَيْنَ طَرَفَيْهِ حَمْداً وَشُكْراً وَأجْراً وَذُخْراً وَفَضْلاً وَإحْسَاناً.
transliteration: wa-amla lana ma bayna ṭarafayhi ḥamdan wa-shukran wa-ajran wa-ẓukhran wa-faḍlan wa-iḥsanan
english_text: and fill what lies between its two sides for us with praise and thanksgiving, wages and stores, bounty and beneficence!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ يسِّرْ عَلَى الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ مَؤُونَتَنَا، وَامْلا لَنَا مِنْ حَسَنَاتِنَا صَحَائِفَنَا.
transliteration: allāhumma yassir ʿalā al-kirām al-kātibīna maʾūnatanā wa-amla lana min hasanatina saha'ifana
english_text: O God, ease our burden on the Noble Writers, fill our pages for us with our good deeds,

arabic_text: وَلاَ تُخْزِنَا عِنْدَهُمْ بِسُوءِ أَعْمَالِنَا.
transliteration: walā tukhzinā ʿindahum bisūʾi aʿmālinā
english_text: and degrade us not before them with our evil works!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي كُلِّ سَاعَة مِنْ سَاعَاتِهِ حَظّاً مِنْ عِبَادِكَ ، وَنَصِيباً مِنْ شُكْرِكَ وَشَاهِدَ صِدْق مِنْ مَلائِكَتِكَ
transliteration: allāhumma ijʿal lana fī kulli sāʿatin min sāʿātihī ḥazzaan min ʿibādik wa-naṣībān min shukrika wa-shāhida ṣidqan min malāʾikatika
english_text: O God, appoint for us in each of the day's hours a share from Thy servants, a portion of giving thanks to Thee, and a truthful witness among Thy angels!

arabic_text: أللَّهَّمَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ ، وَاحْفَظْنَا مِنْ بَيْنِ أيْدِينَا وَمِنْ خَلْفِنَا وَعَنْ أيْمَانِنَا وَعَنْ شَمَائِلِنَا، وَمِنْ جَمِيْعِ نَوَاحِيْنَا حِفْظاً عَاصِماً مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ هَادِياً إلَى طَاعَتِكَ مُسْتَعْمِلاً لِمَحَبَّتِكَ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa aḥfaẓnā min bayni ʾaydīnā wa min khalfinā wa ʿan ʾaymāninā wa ʿan shamāʾil wa min jamiʿi nawāhīnā ḥifẓan ʿāṣiman min maʿṣiyatika hādiyān ilā ṭāʿatika mustaʿmilan li-maḥabbatika
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and safeguard us from before us and behind us, from our right hands and our left hands and from all our directions, a safeguarding that will preserve from disobeying Thee, guide to obeying Thee, and be employed for Thy love!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَوَفِّقْنَا فِي يَوْمِنَا هذا ولَيْلَتِنَا هذِهِ وَفِي جَمِيعِ أيّامِنَا لاسْتِعْمَالِ الْخَيْرِ وَهِجْـرَانِ الشَرِّ وَشُكْـرِ ألنِّعَمِ وَاتّبَـاعِ السُّنَنِ وَمُجَانَبَةِ البِدَعِ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa waffiqnā fī yawminā hādhā wa laylatinā hādhīhi wa fī jamiʿi ayyāminā la astiʿmaalil khayri wahijraanish sharrish shukrinniʿami wa at-tibāʿi as-sunnah wa mujānabati al-bidʿi
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and give us success in this day of ours, this night of ours, and in all our days, to employ the good, stay away from the evil, give thanks for favours, follow the Sunna's norms, avoid innovations,

arabic_text: وَالأمْرِ بِـالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالنَّهيِ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَحِياطَةِ الإسْلاَمِ وَانْتِقَاصِ الْبَاطِلِ وَإذْلالِهِ وَنُصْرَةِ الْحَقِّ وَإعْزَازِهِ ، وَإرْشَادِ الضَّالِّ ، وَمُعَاوَنَةِ الضَّعِيفِ وَإدْرَاكِ اللَّهِيْفِ.
transliteration: wal-amri bil-maʿrūfi wan-nahyi ʿani-l-munkari waḥiyāṭi al-islāmi wa intiqāṣi al-bāṭili wa ʾidhlālihi wa-nuṣraṭi al-haqqi wa-iʿzāzihi, wa-irshādi al-ḍālli wa muʿāwanati al-ḍaʿīfī wa idrāki allahīf
english_text: enjoin good behaviour, forbid the disapproved, defend Islam, diminish falsehood and abase it, help the truth and exalt it, guide the misguided, assist the weak, and reach out to the troubled!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْهُ أيْمَنَ يَوْم عَهِدْنَاهُ ، وَأَفْضَلَ صَاحِب صَحِبْنَاهُ ، وَخَيْرَ وَقْت ظَلِلْنَا فِيْهِ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wajʿalhu aymana yawm ʿahidnāhu wa-afḍala ṣāḥibi ṣaḥibnāh wa khayra waqtin ẓalilna fiih
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and make this the most fortunate day we have known, the most excellent companion we have accompanied, and the best time in which we have lingered!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أرْضَى مَنْ مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْـلُ وَالنَّهَارُ مِنْ جُمْلَةِ خَلْقِكَ وأَشْكَـرَهُمْ لِمَا أوْلَيْتَ مِنْ نِعَمِكَ وَأقْوَمَهُمْ بِمَـا شَرَعْتَ مِنْ شَرَائِعِكَ ، وَأَوْقَفَهُمْ عَمَّا حَذَّرْتَ مِنْ نَهْيِكَ.
transliteration: wa-aj'alna min arḍā man marrā ʿalayhi al-laylu wa al-nahāru min jumlati khalqika wa-ashkharahum lima awlayta min niʿamika wa aqwaamahum bimaa sharaʿta min sharaaʾiki wa aqfahum ʿamma haddarthahum min nahyika
english_text: Place us among the most satisfied of all Thy creatures whom night and day have passed by, the most thankful of them for the favours Thou hast done, the firmest of them in the laws Thou hast set down in the Shari'a, and the most unyielding of them toward the prohibited acts against which Thou hast cautioned!

arabic_text: اللَهُمَّ إنِّي اشْهِدُكَ وَكَفَى بِكَ شَهِيداً وَاُشْهِدُ سَمَاءكَ وَأَرْضَكَ وَمَنْ أَسْكَنْتَهُما مِنْ مَلائِكَتِـكَ وَسَائِرِ خَلْقِكَ فِي يَوْمِي هَذَا ، وَسَاعَتِي هَذِهِ ، وَلَيْلَتِي هَذِهِ ، وَمُسْتَقَرِّي هَذَا ، أنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أنْتَ اللهُ الِذَّي
transliteration: allāhumma innī ash-haduka wa kafā bika shahīdan wa ushhidu samā'aka wa arḍaka wa-man 'askan-ta-hu-ma min mala'ikatika wa-sa'iri khalqika fi yawmi ha-tha wasāʿatī hadhihi, wa laylatī hadhihi, wa mustaqarri hadha 'anni ash-hadu annaka anta allah al-ladhi..
english_text: O God, I call Thee to witness - and Thou art sufficient witness - and I call Thy heaven and Thy earth to witness and Thy angels and Thy other creatures who inhabit them in this my day, this my hour, this my night, and this my resting place, that I bear witness that Thou art God,

arabic_text: لاَ إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ قَائِمٌ بِـالْقِسْطِ ، عَدْلٌ فِي الْحُكْم ، رَؤُوفٌ بِالْعِبَادِ ، مَالِكُ المُلْكِ رَحِيمٌ بِالْخَلْقِ ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ وَخِيرَتُكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ ،
transliteration: lā ilāha illā anta qā'im bil-qisṭ ʿadlun fi al-ḥukm, raʾūfun bil-ʿibād māliku al-mulki raḥīmun bil-khalqi waʾanna muḥammadan ʿabduka wa rasuluka wa khīratuka min khalaqika
english_text: other than whom there is no god, Upholding justice, Equitable in judgement, "Clement to the servants" (2:207), "Master of the kingdom" (3:26), Compassionate to the creatures, and that Muhammad is Thy servant and Thy messenger, Thy chosen from among Thy creatures.

arabic_text: حَمَّلْتَهُ رِسَالَتَكَ فَأدَّاهَا وَأَمَرْتَهُ بالنُّصْحِ لاُِمَّتِهِ فَنَصَحَ لَهَا.
transliteration: ḥammaltahu risālatuka fa'addāhā wa'amartahu bil-nuṣḥi li'ummatihi fanasaḥa lahā
english_text: Thou didst charge him with Thy message and he delivered it; Thou didst command him to counsel his community and he counselled it.

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ أكْثَرَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
transliteration: allāhumma faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih akthara mā ṣallayta ʿalā aḥad min khalqik
english_text: O God, so bless Muhammad and his Household more than Thou hast blessed any of Thy creatures!

arabic_text: وَآتِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا آتَيْتَ أَحَداً مِنْ عِبَادِكَ وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ وَأكْرَمَ مَا جَزَيْتَ أَحَداً مِنْ أَنْبِيائِـكَ عَنْ أمَّتِهِ.
transliteration: wa ātihī ʿannā afḍala mā ātayta aḥadan min ʿibādika wa-ajzihī ʿannā afḍala wa-akrama mā jazayta aḥadan min anbiyāʾika ʿan ummatihi
english_text: Give him for our sake the best Thou hast given any of Thy servants, and repay him on our behalf better and more generously than Thou hast repaid any of Thy prophets on behalf of his community!

arabic_text: إنَّـكَ أَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بِالْجَسِيمِ الْغَـافِر لِلْعَظِيمِ ، وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ مِنْ كُلِّ رَحِيم ،
transliteration: 'innaka 'anta al-mannān bil-jasīmi al-ghāfir lil-'aẓīm wa anta arḥamu min kulli rahim
english_text: Thou art All-kind with immensity, the Forgiver of the great, and Thou art more merciful than every possessor of mercy!

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ الأَخْيَارِ الانْجَبِينَ.
transliteration: faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih al-ṭayyibīna al-ṭāhirīna al-akh'yār al-anjabin
english_text: So bless Muhammad and his Household, the good, the pure, the chosen, the most distinguished!
